summary: PepGen Inc. filed Form 8-K on August 6, 2026, reporting second-quarter 2026 financial results, updating its corporate presentation, and disclosing that an independent DSMB recommended advancing its Phase 2 FREEDOM2-DM1 study to the highest dose cohort (12.5 mg/kg) and escalating the open-label extension dose to 10 mg/kg. No special situation event such as a merger, tender offer, delisting, or management change occurred. The filing is a routine operational update with clinical trial progress, therefore it does not fall under any special-situations category.
